definitions.gloss: leisurely; calmly; in no hurry; at ease
definitions.explanation: Acting in a relaxed, unhurried manner, with a sense of composure and ease. Conveys a positive image of someone who is not rushed or stressed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{悠々|ゆうゆう}と⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: A cat is walking along leisurely.

examples.japanese: {定年後|ていねんご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悠々|ゆうゆう}と⟦{暮|く}らしたい→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: After retirement, I want to live at ease.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鷹|たか}→鷹：02218_taka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{悠々|ゆうゆう}と⟦{大空|おおぞら}→大空：25275_oozora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{舞|ま}っている→舞う：04573_mau⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The sight of the hawk gliding leisurely across the wide sky was beautiful.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as an adverb with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: {悠々|ゆうゆう}と + verb. The base form ⟦{悠々|ゆうゆう}→悠々：04010_yuuyuu⟧ can also function as a な-adjective: ⟦{悠々|ゆうゆう}→悠々：04010_yuuyuu⟧な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (a leisurely life). Often describes animals, nature, or people acting with calm dignity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悠々|ゆうゆう}と⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧ (to live at ease)
- {悠々|ゆうゆう}と⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk leisurely)
- {悠々|ゆうゆう}と⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ (to remain composed)
- ⟦{悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}→悠々自適：18215_yuuyuujiteki⟧ (living a life of leisure — four-character compound)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧ is more casual and everyday, while {悠々|ゆうゆう}と has a more elegant, literary feel and often implies dignity or grandeur.
